First the first Pledge of Aqabah (c. 621 CE), then the change of qiblah (2 AH), then the expulsion of Banu al-Nadir (4 AH, some place it earlier), then Abu Bakr leads the Hajj (9 AH), and last the Battle of Qadisiyyah (c. 15 AH). Historians give different years for some of these, but the order here is clear either way.

First the Isra and Mi'raj (before the Hijrah, year disputed), then the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah (6 AH), then the Battle of Yamamah (11 to 12 AH), then the caliphate of Umar begins (13 AH), and last Jerusalem comes under Muslim rule (c. 16 to 17 AH). Historians give different years for some of these, but the order here is clear either way.

First Masjid an-Nabawi is built (1 AH), then the Battle of Badr (2 AH, Ramadan), then the delayed Umrah is performed (7 AH), then the Battle of Mu'tah (8 AH), and last the Battle of Yarmuk (c. 15 AH).

events.text: The passing of the Prophet ﷺ
The compilation of the Qur'an under Abu Bakr

hard.explain: First the Battle of Khaybar (7 AH), then the Battle of Hunayn (8 AH), then the Farewell Pilgrimage (10 AH), then the passing of the Prophet ﷺ (11 AH, 632 CE), and last the compilation of the Qur'an under Abu Bakr (c. 12 AH).

events.text: The standardisation of the Qur'an under Uthman

hard.explain: First the journey to Ta'if (c. 619 to 620 CE), then the Battle of Uhud (3 AH), then the Battle of Khandaq (5 AH, some say 4 AH), then the conquest of Makkah (8 AH, Ramadan), and last the standardisation of the Qur'an under Uthman (c. 25 to 30 AH). Historians give different years for some of these, but the order here is clear either way.

events.text: The boycott of Banu Hashim begins

hard.explain: First Public preaching begins (c. 613 CE), then the boycott of Banu Hashim begins (c. 617 CE), then the Hijrah to Madinah (622 CE), then the conquest of Makkah (8 AH, Ramadan), and last the caliphate of Uthman begins (23 AH).

events.text: Abd al-Muttalib, the Prophet's grandfather, dies
The boycott of Banu Hashim begins

hard.explain: First Abd al-Muttalib, the Prophet's grandfather, dies (c. 578 CE), then the Prophet ﷺ marries Khadijah (c. 595 CE), then the first revelation (c. 610 CE), then Public preaching begins (c. 613 CE), and last the boycott of Banu Hashim begins (c. 617 CE).
